caveats.title: Pod has been idle for 7.27h (~$21.74 sunk cost, no training output)
caveats.detail: finalize_and_launch.sh was placed on /workspace/ at 22:14 UTC (3min after PID 504 jupyter started) but never invoked. There is no evidence anyone ran ./finalize_and_launch.sh — finalize.log, cost_watchdog.log, train.log all absent. The conscious_decoder.cpython-311.pyc shows ONE import happened at 22:14 (sanity check), then the session ended. The previous agent claimed in launch_status.json (22:08 UTC) 'next_steps' included 'wait for rsync, mark immutable, start watchdog, start training' — none of these post-rsync steps were executed. The watchdog_refresh audit (04:28 UTC) accepted at face value that training was running (assumed remaining_eta_h=1.95) without verifying via SSH/nvidia-smi.

caveats.title: Launching training NOW would breach $25 hard cap
caveats.detail: Already-spent $21.74. Cap is $25. Remaining budget is $3.26 = ~1.09h of GPU time. Full 25K training needs 8.3h. Two options: (a) RAISE cap to $46.56 with operator approval, (b) kill pod NOW (sunk cost $21.74 lost), reprovision fresh. Per task constraint 'DO NOT preempt or kill pod (under cap)' — at $21.74 we are technically under $22 watchdog kill threshold by $0.26, but real-clock ticks ~$0.05/min so we'll cross $22 in ~5min. Operator decision required IMMEDIATELY.

caveats.title: Watchdog polls clm-v4-paradigm-d-25k-final but launch_train.sh would push to p9-paradigm-d-25k

caveats.title: HF_TOKEN written in plaintext at /workspace/launch_train.sh:21
caveats.detail: Previous launcher embedded HF_TOKEN=hf_GjzwCY... in the wrapper script. Per raw#15 we redact here. Pod is secure ondemand (root-only access) so blast radius is limited to the current pod, but the token will persist on the pod's volume even after termination if volume is reattached. Mitigation: after training completes (or pod kill), rotate HF_TOKEN. This audit deliberately does not echo the full token in any output.
